title: White Kitchen — Yasnaya Polyana
visualBrief: Complete independent medium-fi White Kitchen exterior: low log shell, closed green hipped standing-seam roof, pale capped chimney seated through the roof, one real recessed wooden door, two real recessed white-framed divided windows, log corner ends, modest plinth and supported low threshold. Photo/aerial interpretation, with explicit positional and hidden-detail uncertainty. No adjacent icehouse/woodshed, planting, sign lettering, people or copied photo pixels are baked in.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: The museum group photograph identifies the central low log White Kitchen, green hip, pale chimney, left wooden door and two divided white windows. Ordinary aerial imagery shows the matching separate green roof in the service courtyard behind Tolstoy House, with the southwest flower bed matching the ground photo. The retained PMTiles and current OSM neighborhood map omit this footprint; reject toilet way167382259 as unrelated. Photo-derived roof center[37.526028,54.076367] and9.6x7m plan are author estimates, about5m positional/15degree facing uncertainty, not an OSM or surveyed footprint. X southeast follows the visible roof; front+Z southwest faces the flower bed. Existing mapped buildings stay independent.
